scope: Agent-observed product UI; no listening or physical synchronization measurement

Loading a supported two-stream LT movie after the rejection restores the picture.
Selecting LT stream 2 displays that stream while retaining excluded embedded audio.
Physical audio device stays closed and monitor gain stays -30 dB throughout these GUI observations.
The candidate product was closed after checking; no installation was changed.
